title: National Startup Day: built in Mumbai
hook: National Startup Day is tomorrow. A note from a team building in Mumbai.
caption:
National Startup Day is tomorrow. A note from a team building in Mumbai.

What we work on, in one line: helping D2C brands understand why an ad won or lost, so the next one starts from what the last one learned.

It is slower work than it sounds. Reading an ad means noticing the hook, the cast, the pacing, the setting and the ask, and then checking which of them the numbers agree with.

To every founder and early team building in India today: we know the days are long. Keep going.

Follow @galvor.ai to see what we are learning.
alt_text: Festival-style card in Galvor violet and gold with a rocket motif. It reads Built in Mumbai, then: for every ad to make the next one better. Below: happy National Startup Day from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: So that *every ad* makes the next one better.
slides.sub: Happy National Startup Day from all of us at Galvor.
